fusions.name: Gaff Bite
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed line that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Reel It In
fusions.desc: Snags a target up to 6 tiles away at or below 25% health and deals 20 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and slows it by 25% for 2 seconds. It can only strike a target that low.

fusions.name: Line and Lure
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds. A circling escort fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbs Torn Loose
fusions.desc: Every hit you land sets a barb in that enemy, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it tears them all out: you are healed for 4% of your maximum health per barb (20% at full). Unfed, a barb fades every 4 seconds.
